notes.title: FSOG 3 Valentine's Update is here!
notes.notes:
Hey there, friends! 

Happy Valentine's Day to you all! Let the loved ones of yours know how much you love them tonight. And we've prepared decent discounts for you to help in this case! Grab Furry Shades Of Gay 3 with a nice discount of 30% now and pick up other games in the series with a discount of 50%!

Now, let's celebrate together with a new story, shall we?

Evan and Master are back! 

This Valentine’s Day is special for Evan. Him and his Master have been together for quite a while, and he’s excited to spend this special day together. He's a little nervous though? What are they to each other? Friends with benefits or something more? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/86db977214ff80abd5d094b18018b51fd29c23df.png

You can tell he's not the only one having a crisis there - his Master is clearly trying to tell Evan something important. Will they get distracted during their happy little dinner with all the gear in Master's house, or will their choice be a little more romantic this time? 

Find out in the story! There are more secrets to this couple than you think. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/d7f2fdb6f4f4bf06016e693127a9802a88d3c704.png

Wishlist our new game, if you're into girls as well:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2221840/Sex_and_the_Furry_Titty_3_Come_Inside_Sweety/

And if you're into solving mysteries, boys, girls and other funky sexy creatures, we invite you into our Mansion of Memories:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2575040/Mansion_of_Memories/

Join us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/furlough_games
Hang out with us on Discord server: https://discord.com/invite/PZJfRpRRqR

XO, 
Shane

notes.notes:

Enjoy!

notes.title: Christmas bonus update is out!
notes.notes:
Hey there, friends! 

Big Christmas bonus art update is out! 

Get ready for Christmas with our new festive photo album full of naughty boys! Read a set of mini stories and get Christmas-y with us! 

Guess who's made it to Krampus's Bad Boy List, help gym buddies exchange their presents and watch what happens in the police station during the holidays! Play the good old match-3 game to unlock new artworks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/e7eb52f85e2030142d23d72fcb3c25b22117eae0.png

Help Robbie make a remarkable Christmas photoshoot, Evan - to wrap his special present for his Master, and Ennis - to build up his courage to impress Jack! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/9d619442fbef71ee80847e4d963b0d25265422f1.png

For sure, you'll be pleased to know that just in time for the holidays our games are on sale!  Don't forget to grab the gifts for your naughty friends with a decent discount! 

You can also add Furry Shades Of Gay 3 to your wishlist, so you won't miss the release of new stories! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1953540/Furry_Shades_of_Gay_3_Still_Gayer/

Join us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/furlough_games
Hang out with us on Discord server: https://discord.com/invite/PZJfRpRRqR

notes.title: COMMUNITY ITEMS + BONUS STORY UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Hey there, friends!

Shane is here, and I'm glad we've met again, are you? :ls_heart: 

This year is going to be full of new releases and surprises. I know we've talked about community items right before the New Year's hit, but today I think it's time to share some more information on what comes next! 

Community items are almost here!

Yep, that's right! Soon you'll be able to decorate your profiles with all-new animated backgrounds (even for mini-profiles!), user pics, trade new cards and use long awaited emojis! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/bc35667f15e8040a67ada55d7f1bc3dc5341c496.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/7664d7dcdab6c69237c4283370f3e4261493411e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/8ebb4d2df4caebfb78be86bc9d8dfb04f37a9864.png

Isn't it nice to have an animated frame for your profile picture? Can't show you how good it's gonna look, you'll have to find out yourself soon! But for now, I've sneaked into our files and stolen a preview for one of those. Shhh... Don't scare Jack off! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/3d99a75b569fbd98d97be7815198ca463fd08839.png

Valentine's next: bonus story!

The love is in the air already, though it's still January, we have to be ready, right? Well, we're working on the bonus story. Old characters will meet you again, in the new diverse plot just in time for the St. Valentine’s Day, romantic story for all the horny boys out there! And I can even give you a hint on who's gonna come back! Do you recognize them? Name them down in the comments! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/05d3ef1d98db9779ff4cbad6694ee55b699775d2.jpg

These are all news for today, don't forget to party with us in our social media! See you soon!

XOXO

Shane

notes.notes:
Hey, friends! 

I'm here to remind you that the pre-release raffle is happening, and you can enter it under this post: 

PRE-RELEASE RAFFLE!

You can win keys to Furry Shades Of Gay 2 and Steam gift cards, so don't miss out on this opportunity! 

The winners will be chosen randomly, and the results will be posted on December  9, 8:00 AM PST. Please, make sure that your account is publicly visible, otherwise we won’t be able to contact you and send you the keys and gift cards!

We're also doing games and giveaways on our Discord server, and this is a perfect opportunity to get some sneak pics from the upcoming game, win the key and have lots of fun with our community!

notes.title: WINTER IS COMING AND SO IS RELEASE DAY!
notes.notes:
Hi there, friends!

It’s Shane again, and today is the day when I’m finally going to tell you a huge secret. I simply can’t keep it to myself anymore, so be good friends to me and don’t tell anyone, okay? Just kidding, tell everyone, because Furry Shades Of Gay 2: a Shade Gayer is coming to your Steam libraries December, 9th! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/59f788eb223c9eba110e949fcd78d0c8569aadd6.png

Lots of new stories with different ways to end them, body fluids, adventures and even a nice gym training will arrive to your PCs this December. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/2f38407a8aa26aed94deb4206cbfe57011ea0812.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/eec61cb5c03622d22c736a04af04551d4f159bb1.png

New situations, new heroes and widely loved puzzles, what else can anyone wish for Christmas? We’re in love with our new characters and can’t wait to share more stuff about them with you before you see the game on December, 9th! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/7617b49845c7a1c730da09ebe615d2876faee614.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/96bae37f55ba0c78f863825dd84a97690011234a.png

We make all of our games with huge love to our community, so we’ve decided that we should make a present to you - so we’re going to launch a lottery with nice presents and gifts. So be sure to subscribe to the community page and all of our social media to keep up with updates and news about our games and the lottery. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41097121/5c883749afe1270d2d8b9556519a847741db4878.gif


Honorable mention!
Our other games are getting a Christmas update, so make sure to check out Furry Shades Of Gay and Sex And The Furry Titty and see what we’re going to gift you this holiday season! 

Follow our Twitter: @furlough_games
Join our Discord server: https://discord.com/invite/PZJfRpRRqR

That's all for now, my dears, I hope you're having a good weekend!

All the love,
Shane
